ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; high-intensity pixels (RGB values > 200) occupy approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity pixels (RGB values < 60) restricted to the trailing edges and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white region across the central and proximal areas of both lobes. Low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a continuous jagged band along the entire trailing edge, with significant contiguous expansion at the distal tips. One isolated, circular low-intensity cluster is detected in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the visible fluke vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitudes of peaks and valleys range from 4 to 12 pixels; serrations are more pronounced and irregular on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves characterizing both lobes, following an outward and upward arc from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned grey linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular dark-pigmented focal mark (approx. 10 pixels in diameter) on the right lobe. The far-left distal tip exhibits a jagged, truncated morphology suggesting historical tissue loss or irregular scarring.
